title: Dessy X embraces inner struggle in her new hit, "Depression"
htmlContent:
American Based artist Dessy X is a talented singer and songwriter who has taken the reins of her future and is currently pursuing her dream of being a musical prodigy. Dessy X brings you her recent track, "Depression."

Dessy X's "Depression" is from an EP, "5 Realms of Grief". It's like the stages, but this expression of emotion is much larger than that. She manages to shine in the storm of the music with a masterful voice that delivers the writing with extraordinary charisma in the delivery, to make it a record that knocks for every second that she gives us.
